requiredUICaption: Imagem ilustrativa gerada por IA. Não representa o modelo ou desenho exato.
usage: Only models for which an authentic model-specific photo could not be obtained. Never replace available original product images. No exact-model, tread or performance claim.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square ecommerce fallback illustration. Generate one generic UNBRANDED passenger-road car tire, upright in three-quarter view, centered and entirely visible with comfortable margins. Style: high quality restrained 3D product illustration with realistic charcoal black rubber material, clearly a generic illustrative rendering rather than an authentic branded product photo. Simple generic invented road tread, not any specific actual tire model or exact tread design. Clean bright white studio background, soft contact shadow, neutral studio light defining tire edge and tread. No wheel rim. Absolutely no logos, brand names, model names, lettering, numbers, size markings, ratings, certification markings, watermark or text anywhere. This image is solely an illustrative fallback, not evidence of product appearance or performance. Do not include a label in the image; its AI-illustration disclosure will be displayed by the website outside it.
